map.note: Selected certified QCA is preserved verbatim

device_interface.scope: Declared input/output terminal counts and nonempty device; not signal timing or waveform equivalence

clock_arrival.scope: Discrete clock-zone arrival at every gate, with each PI launched in cycle zero at its own phase. Different outputs may have different latency. Same-phase movement and gate internals add zero clock ticks; no electrical settling-time or waveform signoff.

physical_routes.scope: Ordered source-to-sink template ports, route-owned exact XYZ sites, complete L0/L1/L2 transition columns, and retained route continuity after optional terminal trimming. Does not certify electrostatic interference, clock timing, or device-level functional simulation.

validation.scope: Geometric routes, physical gate ports, and forward clock steps; not RTL equivalence, latency alignment, or device-level functional signoff.

phase_repair.scope: Discrete clock-tile synchronization; not electrical delay, device waveforms, or physical signoff.
